$comment: Which S3 bucket the quick-create links in quick-create-links.md point at.
AN EMPTY BUCKET IS THE SHIPPING DEFAULT, NOT AN UNFILLED BLANK. ASH publishes
these templates to no bucket, for the same reason it publishes no container
image -- see README.md, 'Hosting the templates for one-click launch', and
carries no URLs, and is expected to keep carrying none.
This file is here for ADOPTERS. Copy the templates to a bucket you own, set it
below, and run 'python3 scripts/render_quick_create_links.py render' to get
working links for your own account. quick-create-links.md has the full sequence
under 'Rendering links for your own bucket'.
Do not commit a bucket you do not control, and do not put a sample bucket name
here to make the output look complete. The renderer emits an explicit
NO-BUCKET-CONFIGURED placeholder instead of an example URL precisely so that no
link in this repository can point somewhere plausible and dead.
JSON rather than TOML so this reads on every Python this repository supports:
requires-python is >=3.10, tomllib arrived in 3.11, and tomli is not a
dependency -- so a TOML config would break the 3.10 leg of the unit-test matrix.
